title: Optically Derived Radio-Frequency Benchmark in Methanol: A Sub-kHz Reference for Astrophysical Tests of Fundamental Physics
summary: Methanol radio lines observed in space provide sensitive probes of whether the proton-to-electron mass ratio has changed over cosmic time, but such tests require laboratory rest frequencies with very high accuracy. Here we determine the frequency of the astrophysically important 12.2 GHz $3_{-1}$E -- $2_{0}$E transition of CH$_3$OH by measuring near-infrared rovibrational transitions rather than the microwave line directly.
